svg.title: A three-color sponge blend in five pictures. 1: a wide, damp sponge rubbed on yellow, pink and purple, three stripes side by side. 2: dab it on the plate a few times so the stripes meet softly. 3: dab it on the paper, keeping the colors in the same direction. 4: dab a little left and right over the two places where the colors meet. Done: a smooth blend from yellow through pink to purple, with two blending zones and soft edges.
